title: Returning from the clock scan
statement: Let $K$ and $W$ be finite Boolean-alphabet Turing machines, and let $c$ be a configuration of $W$ on Boolean input $x$, with state $q$ and output register $r$. Choose work-tape contents $kt$ and head positions $kh$ for the tapes corresponding to $K$, and let $\tau:\mathbb Z\to\mathrm{Option}(\mathrm{Bool})$ describe the clock tape. Suppose $\tau(-1)$ is blank. For every natural number $j$ such that $\tau(i)$ is nonblank for every natural number $i<j$, running the clock machine for $j+1$ steps from the configuration with state $\mathrm{ret}(q,r)$, underlying configuration $c$, clock tape $\tau$, clock-head position $j-1$, tapes $kt,kh$, and empty output yields the configuration with state $\mathrm{dec}(q,r)$, the same underlying configuration and tapes, clock tape $\tau$, clock-head position $0$, and empty output.
hypotheses_covered: $K$ and $W$ are finite Turing machines over Boolean symbols
$c$ is a configuration of $W$ on Boolean input $x$
$q$ is a state of $W$ and $r$ is an output-register value
$kt$ gives the contents of the $K$ work tapes
$kh$ gives the head positions of the $K$ work tapes
$\tau$ maps integer positions to optional Boolean symbols
